subject: Biology SL
question: Answer all parts using the shared microscope-style stimulus.

stimulus.title: Leaf epidermis with stomata
stimulus.description: A schematic microscope-style field shows epidermal cells and four stomata. The central pore of one stoma is marked X.
stimulus.note: For part (b), the marked guard cell is 1.5 times the length of the 20 µm scale bar. The diagram is original and schematic, not a real micrograph.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the structure marked X.
markscheme: The stomatal pore / stoma is identified.
markschemeJa: Xは気孔（stoma / stomatal pore）である。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: The marked guard cell is 1.5 times the length of the 20 µm scale bar. Calculate the actual length of the guard cell.
markscheme: Actual guard-cell length = 30 µm, with an appropriate unit.
markschemeJa: ガードセルの実際の長さは30 µmで、適切な単位を付ける。

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.question: Outline how stomatal density could be estimated from microscope fields of known area.
markscheme: Count the stomata in a known field area and express the count per unit area.
markschemeJa: 既知面積の視野内の気孔数を数え、単位面積あたりの個数として表す。
parts.modelAnswer: Count the stomata in a known field area and divide by the area to obtain stomata per unit area.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 既知面積の視野で気孔を数え、その数を面積で割って単位面積あたりの気孔数を求めます。

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.question: Suggest one way to improve the reliability of the stomatal-density estimate.
markscheme: Sample several randomly selected fields / leaves and calculate a mean stomatal density.
markschemeJa: 複数のランダムに選んだ視野または葉を測定し、平均気孔密度を求める。
parts.modelAnswer: Count stomata in several randomly selected fields and calculate a mean density.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 複数のランダムな視野で気孔数を測定し、平均気孔密度を求めます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Explain how guard cells regulate gas exchange while limiting water loss.
markscheme: Changes in guard-cell turgor open or close the stomatal pore.
Opening permits carbon dioxide diffusion for photosynthesis but also increases water-vapour loss; closing the pore reduces water loss when water conservation is important.
markschemeJa: ガードセルの膨圧変化によって気孔が開閉する。
開口すると光合成のための二酸化炭素拡散が可能になる一方で水蒸気損失も増え、閉口すると水を節約する必要があるときの水分損失を減らせる。
parts.modelAnswer: Guard-cell turgor controls the width of the stomatal pore. When the pore opens, carbon dioxide can diffuse into the leaf for photosynthesis, but water vapour is also lost. Closing the pore reduces water loss.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ガードセルの膨圧が気孔の開き具合を調節します。気孔が開くと光合成に必要な二酸化炭素が葉内へ拡散できますが、水蒸気も失われます。閉じることで水分損失を減らせます。
